THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, OCTOBER
（印：C. & S. ... No. S. B. D. 1707 c:e 5 - 11 - 30.）

ACCORDING to the Chinese press,
aeroplanes ordered from Germany
for the proposed Nanking-Berlin
Air Service will be brought to China
in February next year when a test
flight will be made by one of the
'planes between Nanking and Pe-
king and another Peking and Urga
(Outer Mongolia). It is expected,
says the Chinese press, that the in-
auguration of the Nanking-Berlin
Air Service will take place in May,
next year.

NANKING-BERLIN AIR
SERVICE

Shipment of Planes Due in
January

Nanking, Oct. 25.
A shipment of aeroplanes destin-
ed for the inauguration of the new
Nanking-Berlin air mail and pas-
senger service operated by the
"Euro-Asia Aviation Corporation"
will be dispatched here from Ger-
many at the end of the month by
the Hamburg-America Line. A re-
port to this effect has been receiv-
ed at the Ministry of Communica-
tions from Mr. Shuang Tsing,
Counsellor to the Ministry, who has
been making the necessary arrange-
ments at Berlin.
The Corporation has decided
upon the operation of the Nanking-
Peking section of the proposed air
line soon after the arrival of the
aeroplanes. As they are expected
to be here by January, 1931, it is
hoped to start a regular service
early next spring. Steps are now
being taken for the construction of
landing fields along the Nanking-
Peking route.—Kuo Min

《华北星期新闻》，十月
（印：C. & S. ... 编号 S. B. D. 1707 c:e 5 - 11 - 30.）

据中文报刊报道，为拟议中的南京—柏林航空服务而从德国订购的飞机，将于明年二月运抵中国，届时将有一架飞机在南京与北平之间、另一架在北平与库伦（外蒙古）之间进行试飞。中文报刊称，预计南京—柏林航空服务将于明年五月正式开通。

南京—柏林
航空服务

飞机预计一月运抵

南京，10月25日。
一批旨在用于开通由“欧亚航空公司”运营的新式南京—柏林航空邮件及客运服务的飞机，将于本月底由汉堡—美洲航运公司从德国发运至此。交通部已收到该部参事双清（Shuang Tsing，音译）先生关于此事的报告，他一直在柏林进行必要的安排。
该公司决定在飞机抵达后不久，即开始运营拟议航线的南京—北平段。鉴于飞机预计将于1931年1月运抵此处，故希望于明年初春启动定期航班。目前正采取措施，沿南京—北平航线修建着陆场。——《国民新闻》
